title: create-e2e-saas
shortDescription: NPM CLI that scaffolds a MERN authentication starter with JWT, OTP, and email verification flows.
description: create-e2e-saas is an npm CLI package that bootstraps a full-stack authentication baseline with client/server templates. It packages a reusable starter with Node tooling and templates for rapid SaaS or hackathon setup.
myContributions: Built and published a reusable CLI scaffold workflow for full-stack authentication apps.
Created starter templates for frontend and backend auth modules.
Documented onboarding and configuration flows for rapid setup.
